description: Different model profiles should preserve exact Cargo workspace package ownership, the package-local command, and direct integration-test evidence.

lockedFields.reason: A literal Cargo workspace member should retain an exact package command rather than an aggregate workspace command.
The complete repository-contained workspace graph should not introduce an ownership blocker.
The untested validator should remain the one add-test item.
The asserted checkout service should remain the one extend-test item.
The covered workspace service should retain its stable plan identifier.
Workspace ownership must preserve exact crate-module import provenance.
The imported service call remains consumed by a built-in assertion macro.
The untested workspace validator should retain its stable add-test action.
